claim_boundary: This one-acetone gas-phase source-representer falsifier compares a frozen MACE-MDP atomic induced-moment partition, placed in the inherited one-radial MACE-POLAR Gaussian l<=1 basis, with an independent fixed-geometry QM finite-field induced electrostatic potential at a frozen exterior point set. It invokes no continuum response, PCM energy, implicit solvent, experimental solvation label, model-energy/force claim, fitted width, parameter calibration, training, fine tuning, total solvation prediction, or public Route-2 profile. A pass can admit only this exact source map to a later common-scalar KKT gate; it cannot establish chemical accuracy.
decision_rule: If any numerical or scientific gate fails, reject this exact MACE-MDP atomic-partition plus one-radial 1.5 Angstrom Gaussian induced-source candidate. Do not change the width, select a subset of points, add induced monopoles/higher multipoles, rescale/clip the response, refit weights, use a solvation label, or run an accuracy panel. A pass permits only a separately preregistered common-scalar KKT/continuum and force gate; it does not make the source a final density representation or a total solvation method.

scientific_falsification_gates.interpretation: These pre-execution gates reject a grossly inaccurate induced source representer. Their 0.20/0.30 response tolerances are copied unchanged from the pre-existing frozen QEq/MACE-MDP gas-response falsification protocols, not selected from this candidate. Passing remains insufficient for a total solvent free energy or accuracy claim.
